concerns.text: The plan cites three HuggingFace parquet datasets (bio-datasets/dft23-full, sdmattpotter/dftest61523, sdmattpotter/dftest61623) as the source of “perovskite formulas and band gaps”. These datasets are generic DFT collections and do not guarantee that they contain a sufficient number of ABX₃ perovskite entries. Because the research question specifically requires a curated perovskite dataset (≥ 500 entries after filtering), using a dataset that may lack the required stoichiometry makes the data resource inappropriate for the task. Replace the cited sources with a verified perovskite‑specific DFT dataset (e.g., Materials Project perovskite subset, OQMD perovskite filter, or a Zenodo‑hosted perovskite collection) that explicitly provides the needed composition and band‑gap fields.
